claims.citation: New York Herald, 17 May 1866, p. 9, col. 3
New York Herald, 7 June 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Bark Doretta (Brem), Schurken, Rotterdam, 32 days, with
mdse and 73 passengers, to Funch, Meincke & Wendt. Had
four deaths. May 27, lat 42 57, lon 59 33, spoke ship Eliza-
b[?]th Ribbe (Ham), from Hamburg for New York, 31 days
out.

claims.citation: Lloyd's List, 22 June 1866, p. 4, col. 5 (British Newspaper Archive)

claims.verbatim:
Bark Daretta (Bremt), Schurken, Rotterdam 32 days, with mdse.
and pass. to Funch, Meincke & Wendt.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 5 June 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Ship Senator Iken (Brem), Dannemann, Bremen, 29 days,
with mdse and 490 passengers, to Scholberg & Koper. Passed
Fair Island May 10, crossed the Grand Banks 23d. May 10,
lat 59 53, lon 5 06, passed bark Doretta, from Rotterdam for
New York; 27th, lat 42 26, lon 58 53, steamship Atlantic, hence
for Bremen.
